svg.aria-label: A map of 325 ballparks, soccer grounds and arenas
svg.title: A map of 325 ballparks, soccer grounds and arenas
svg.desc: The world with a marker on each of 325 places: a circle for a place in use today and a diamond for one of the past, baseball parks solid, soccer grounds with a dot in the middle, hockey arenas with a bar across and basketball arenas with an upright bar.
